name: Giltspiel
description: Giltspiel is a four-player fixed-partnership trump trick game from Tyrol that combines five-trick play with open betting on three figures: Gleich (sets), Hanger (sequences), and Spiel (majority of tricks).

content.text: Giltspiel is a four-player fixed-partnership trump trick game from Tyrol that combines five-trick play with open betting on three figures: Gleich (sets), Hanger (sequences), and Spiel (majority of tricks).
Giltspiel was documented in Tyrol as an old game by the mid-19th century and is treated as the ancestor of Perlaggen.
4 players in fixed partnerships, partners opposite.
32-card German suits (bells, acorns, hearts, leaves), rank high to low: A K O U 10 9 8 7.
Deal five cards each clockwise in two packets (2+3 or 3+2). Turn the next card up to set trump suit.

items.text: Target Score Choice: Tables commonly agree before play to 11-point or 15-point game length.
Local Signaling Systems: Different groups use different legal visual signal conventions for suits, trumps, and figure strength.
Perlique Wildcards (Historical): Some historical Tyrolean groups added wild cards, leading to the related game Perlaggen.
